explanation: The AI response failed to identify the correct decade (1990-1999) and consequently listed the wrong set of Category 4 hurricanes. Out of the required set (Bret, Douglas, Greg, Juliette, Kevin, Pauline), only Pauline was mentioned, though in the wrong decade context (Pauline was 1997). The AI also listed several fabricated/incorrect storms (Karl, Norberto, Ophir, Isabel) as excessive answers.
